Speech engine

O‘zbegim does not synthesize voices itself: it uses the voice of another text-to-speech engine on your phone (for example RHVoice) and prepares the text with its own rules. No other text-to-speech engine was found on this phone. Install RHVoice or another engine first.

O‘zbegim speech engine (for the system)
Make O‘zbegim the phone\'s preferred text-to-speech engine and adjust it

When O‘zbegim is the preferred text-to-speech engine, every app that speaks (TalkBack, e-book readers, navigation) sends its text to O‘zbegim. O‘zbegim prepares the text with its own Uzbek rules (Cyrillic, Latin and new Latin scripts, numbers, Roman numerals, phone numbers) and passes it to another engine installed on this phone, which produces the voice. Nothing is sent over the network.
